summary: Frontend-only final verification completed on public URL. Keyboard and direct route behavior are stable, but pointer marker routing is still non-deterministic and fails strict 5/5 loop criteria on desktop and mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Desktop pointer click loop passed 1/5 only (required 5/5); 4 runs stayed on circuit (progress 0.17).
Mobile pointer click loop passed 1/5 only (required 5/5); 4 runs stayed on circuit (progress 0.17).
Mobile clicks on marker group remained at circuit in initial pass; targeted '.marker-hit' clicks route correctly, indicating flaky/ambiguous tap-hit behavior on marker container.

integration_issues.issue: Exact progress 0.305 is achieved intermittently (1/5 desktop, 1/5 mobile), not deterministically 5/5.
Marker group click path is unreliable while inner '.marker-hit' circle path routes correctly to legacy/cars/timeline exact stops.

action_items: Fix marker pointer activation so timeline click lands deterministically at stop 0.305 for 5/5 desktop and 5/5 mobile loops.
Unify mobile tap behavior between marker container and hit circle (same routing outcome for real user taps).
Re-run strict regression: timeline pointer loops, legacy pointer open + Back to Circuit preserve progress, cars pointer exact stop.
Keep existing working behavior: Enter/Space activation, travel-hide during navigation, and no-console/no-overflow state.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation lock/settle implementation works when route activation is actually triggered (keyboard and direct __spatialGo pass).
Observed instability is isolated to pointer marker activation path, likely hit-target/event-target reliability rather than settle logic.
No console errors and no horizontal overflow were observed on tested desktop/mobile viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop timeline pointer loops: [circuit, circuit, timeline, circuit, circuit]. Mobile timeline pointer loops: [circuit, circuit, circuit, timeline, circuit]. Enter/Space on timeline marker pass on both desktop/mobile with progress 0.305. Desktop legacy pointer click opens legacy with 6 stats, travel-hide snapshot true during travel, and Back to Circuit returns overview with coverage label visible. Desktop cars pointer click reaches 0.37 and remains cars after +2.1s. Mobile marker group clicks for legacy/cars stayed at circuit in initial run, but targeted '.marker-hit' clicks route correctly (legacy 0.24, cars 0.37, timeline 0.305).
rca of the issue: Repro: force circuit overview, click marker group [data-testid='chapter-marker-*'], wait 2.3s. Timeline is intermittent and often stays at circuit, especially mobile. Contrast: keyboard Enter/Space and programmatic routes settle correctly; direct '.marker-hit' mobile taps also settle correctly. RCA points to pointer hit/target handling on marker group being unreliable under transformed SVG/mobile tap conditions. Mitigation: make pointer activation deterministic by aligning event binding and hit geometry (ensure consistent pointer target and identical routing branch), then rerun 5+5 strict loops.
